open_markets.title: Will ZEC trimmed mean be below $660.00 by 11:59 PM ET on Nov 30, 2026?
open_markets.rules_primary: If the price of ZEC after issuance and through 11:59 PM ET on Nov 30, 2026 is ever below $660.00, then the market resolves to Yes.
open_markets.rules_secondary: At each minute throughout the market duration, a settlement value is calculated using every minute-by-minute CF ZECUSD_RTI price for ZEC. For each of these individual minute-by-minute checks, the top 20% and bottom 20% of the cumulative dataset are removed before calculating the average of the remaining values. If the trimmed mean associated with any single minute during the period is below the threshold, the market resolves to Yes. This methodology reduces the impact of extreme price spikes or drops. The measurement period runs from when the market is issued until the specified end time. If CF Benchmarks data is unavailable or incomplete at the expiration time, affected strikes resolve to No. For cryptocurrencies with multiple versions, the Exchange will specify which version or ticker is being tracked.

open_markets.title: Will it be confirmed that Ron Wyden publicly backs Chris Van Hollen for Senate Democratic leader when the caucus votes, or says by the end of the next day that they voted for him?
open_markets.rules_primary: If Ron Wyden publicly backs Chris Van Hollen for Senate Democratic leader when the caucus votes, or says by the end of the next day that they voted for him before Jan 3, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
open_markets.rules_secondary:
This must be confirmed, verified, or established as factual by at least one Source Agency.

"The caucus vote" refers to the Senate Democratic caucus's vote on its leader for the 120th Congress. A senator backs Chris Van Hollen by publicly stating that they support him or plan to vote for him as leader. Support conditioned only on Chris Van Hollen remaining a candidate qualifies; support subject to any other condition does not.

The market resolves to Yes if either of the following is confirmed:
Backing Chris Van Hollen is the senator's public position when the caucus votes.
By the end of the day after the vote, the senator says they voted for Chris Van Hollen, including saying "aye" on a voice vote.

A senator's own account of their vote governs over earlier statements. A senator who says they voted against Chris Van Hollen, abstained, or did not vote for him resolves to No. A senator who had not publicly backed Chris Van Hollen before the vote resolves to No if, by the end of the day after the vote, they only say they support him going forward or decline to say whether they supported him. If Chris Van Hollen is elected by acclamation without a vote, only the first route applies.

Once the day after the caucus elects its leader has ended, a senator who has met neither route above resolves to No, without waiting for Jan 3, 2027. A route met by then still counts if a Source Agency confirms it before the market settles. Each market resolves to No if Chris Van Hollen withdraws from the leadership election or the caucus does not elect its leader before Jan 3, 2027. A person who is not eligible to vote in the caucus vote as a senator or senator-elect, including a candidate whose Senate race has not been called by then, resolves to No.

open_markets.title: Will the President sign more than 4 Executive Orders between Nov 22, 2026 and Nov 28, 2026?
open_markets.rules_primary: If the President signs above 4 executive orders during Nov 22, 2026 to Nov 28, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
open_markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The signing date as recorded in the Federal Register determines which period an Executive Order belongs to.
For example, if the period was "Jan 1, 2025 to Jan 7, 2025," and on January 10th the Federal Register published a numbered Executive Order with a January 7th signing date, the market would resolve to Yes.

Payout criteria

An "Executive Order" is a numbered presidential directive that: is formally titled "Executive Order" followed by a number, is signed by the President, is published in the Federal Register, and has the force of law.
All documents officially designated as "Executive Orders" with sequential numbering count, including Executive Orders that are later revoked or amended.

Expiration date

The latest Expiration Date of the Contract shall be two weeks after the end of the period.
If an Executive Order that is dated past Nov 22, 2026 to Nov 28, 2026 is posted to the Federal Register, expiration may be moved to an earlier date.

For example, if the period was "Jan 1, 2025 to Jan 7, 2025," and on January 10th the Federal Register published a numbered Executive Order with a January 7th signing date, the market would resolve to Yes.

Payout criteria

An "Executive Order" is a numbered presidential directive that: is formally titled "Executive Order" followed by a number, is signed by the President, is published in the Federal Register, and has the force of law.
All documents officially designated as "Executive Orders" with sequential numbering count, including Executive Orders that are later revoked or amended.

Expiration date

The latest Expiration Date of the Contract shall be two weeks after the end of the period.
If an Executive Order that is dated past Nov 22, 2026 to Nov 28, 2026 is posted to the Federal Register, expiration may be moved to an earlier date.

disclaimers: All values are from the Kalshi DEMO environment (mock funds). The official docs warn that demo prices and behaviour may not reflect real markets.
dollars_traded_estimate = volume_fp x last_price_dollars. It is an estimate computed here, not an official Kalshi field.
category_basis=keyword rows are heuristic word-boundary matches and are flagged for review; only basis=seed rows are confirmed by the official fee schedule.
Multivariate (combo) markets are excluded from every category: they combine unrelated legs and have their own lifecycle channel.

Two scope corrections are published in counts: natural-gas futures (KXNATGAS15M, official series category Commodities / Pyth NATGAS) are not retail gas prices and Kalshi demo QA fixtures are not live events. Seed series can never be excluded by these rules.
result can be yes, no, scalar, or empty. Nothing is coerced to yes/no.
